correctness.rationale: For all n>=3, the graph-geometric Čech edge-ball formula yields exactly the n(n-1) off-diagonal facets of a join sphere. All proper faces of the n omitted diagonal top facets remain. The relative cellular chain group is Z^n in degree 2n-3; the ambient fundamental class maps to the primitive diagonal, so the exact sequence gives only Z^(n-1) in degree 2n-4. The complex is (2n-5)-connected by high-cell attachment, so Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead proves an actual wedge of n-1 spheres. The orientation degree of simultaneously permuting two simplex boundaries is +1 and shore exchange is (-1)^(n-1), yielding the precise integral quotient permutation module. Radius-two graph balls give the exact stages four and five. A standalone independent finite checker passed on n=3,4,5,6, but finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The crown graph is the canonical regular bipartite graph arising from deletion of a perfect matching. The result gives the complete natural intermediate geometric Čech homotopy type, sharp high-dimensional rank n-1, exact integral S_n×C2 representation, and both following transitions for all sizes. Its contrast with contractibility at scale three for intact K_{n,n} reveals a substantive high-dimensional response to a structured edge defect; the quotient versus augmentation lattice distinction matters integrally. The object, scale and invariant are natural and motivated, not an arbitrary slice or code-only observation.
